hand.charDescription: A mage who attacks with fire.

GoldenHeart: Throws a ball of fire at the enemy.

hand.defense_desc: Raises a wall of flame to obscure the next attack.

hand.charDescription: A phantom clad in obsidian armor, he strikes from the city's shadows.

Dark Blade Slash: Coated in dense dark energy, Shadow Knight's blade cuts through the air to leave a trail of razor-sharp shadow that shatters enemy defenses on impact.

hand.defense_desc: Merges with the shadows to evade the next attack.

hand.charDescription: A knight who carries a shield bright as the morning sun.

Radiant Strike: Swings a sword glowing with sunlight.

hand.defense_desc: Flashes a radiant shield to disrupt the next attack.

hand.charDescription: Meepo is a magical cave elf that summons 5 copies of himself to fight from every front.

Earth Bind: Tosses a net at an enemy, keeping them from play for one turn.
Divided We Stand: Summons five copies to strike the enemy together.

hand.defense_desc: Creates decoys to confuse the next attacker.

hand.charDescription: A mountain monk who channels lightning through his fists.

Lightning Fist: Strikes the enemy with an electrified punch.

hand.defense_desc: Moves with lightning speed to evade the next attack.

hand.charDescription: A swift archer whose arrows ride the wind.

Gale Arrow: Fires an arrow carried by a powerful gust.

hand.defense_desc: Dashes aside on a gust of wind to dodge the next attack.
